items.title: The Male Lead's Little Lion Daughter
items.author: Latine (라티네), MHL, Ttona (또나)
items.description:
The handsome Duke Voreoti is the most terrifying man in the empire, with the coldest of demeanors and a gaze that can kill. But one day, he suddenly says that he wants to… adopt a child?! And that child is me?! After finding me at a shady orphanage, he whisked me away to his snowy palace without a second thought. Now I’m learning all the ways of the feared Voreoti family from his knights. However, things get dicey when the Duke becomes suspicious of my origins. With these fangs and jet black hair, perhaps we are more than just kindred spirits…
 

 
(Source: Tapas)

items.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
items.author: Takata
items.description:
Maki Maehara is always on his own at school. He has no friends or hobbies others share, and he doesn't expect the upcoming academic year to be any different, even surrounded by new faces. And six months later, it seems like he was right-until he runs into his popular classmate Umi Asanagi at a video store! Always at the center of attention and called the "second prettiest in class" by the boys, Asanagi's from a totally different world. But it turns out the two have more overlapping interests than just the B-grade movies they came to check out...and Asanagi asks Maehara to be her friend!



(Source: Yen Press)

items.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
items.author: HIRAKAWA Aya
items.description: Though Ayase Yuu is the son of a renowned and talented actress, he is below average in anything he does. He is entrusted to live under the care of his mother's friend and later discovers that he will also be rooming with the three sisters from his school who possess both beauty and talent. Though Yuu thought that an understanding would be impossible to reach between an ordinary person and those blessed with talent, the three sisters are surprisingly...?!

items.title: Omniscient Reader
items.author: Sing-Shong, UMI
items.description:
Back then, Dok-Ja had no idea. He had no idea his favorite web novel 'Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse' was going to come to life, and that he would become the only person to know how the world was going to end. He also had no idea he would end up becoming the protagonist of this novel-turned-reality. Now, Dok-Ja will go on a journey to change the course of the story and save humankind once and for all.



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

items.title: Who Made Me a Princess
items.author: Plutus, Spoon
items.description:
The story of Athanasia, forsaken princess of the Obelian Empire, ends with her execution at the hands of her own father—or does it? Her tragic tale is the plot of the novel The Lovely Princess. But now, a modern woman who read the book has just woken up as baby Athanasia herself, filled with her own memories and knowledge of the story she’s stuck in! Determined to survive her doomed fate, infant Athanasia embarks on this new life with a plan: avoid attention and hoard valuables to fund her escape. When her plan goes awry, she suddenly needs to charm her way into the good graces of her father, the beautiful tyrant emperor, so he doesn’t kill her again!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)


Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

items.title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter
items.author: Bill K, Neida, SHIN Noah
items.description:
In the mysterious, RPG dungeon-like Tower, Confucius Kim lives a mundane existence, envying all the star hunters. One day, his wish for more is granted with a legendary skill to copy others’ abilities… at the cost of his life. Before he can make sense of it, he’s killed by the #1 hunter, the Flame Emperor! But this activates his skill and now he’s copied a new one, the ability to travel back in time upon death. How will Confucius use these skills to outplay the competition and rise to the top?



(Source: Tapas)

items.title: The Beginning After the End
items.author: TurtleMe, Fuyuki23
items.description: King Grey has unrivaled strength, wealth, and prestige in a world governed by martial ability. However, solitude lingers closely behind those with great power. Reincarnated into a new world filled with magic and monsters, the king has a second chance to relive his life.

items.title: Ctrl+Alt+Resign
items.author: Lee Ha An, Woo Si Mok
items.description:
Max and Joy may sit just inches apart at work, but they're miles apart in every other way. Max prefers to be a fly on the wall, while Joy is the office's social butterfly. So when Max accidentally sees something on Joy's work laptop he wasn't meant to, he's pulled off the wall and thrown straight into the tangled web of workplace dynamics. Maybe this change is exactly what he needed... or is it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Dragonnap
items.author: Jin-Hyeong Choi
items.description:
Yu Jitae is a Regressor wielding limitless power—and he still isn't strong enough to prevent the end of the world. Because four bored, young dragons once descended to Earth for fun, Yu has been caught in an endless cycle of failing to stop the apocalypse. But this time, in yet another timeline, Yu decides to try something different: maybe he can nurture the destruction out of these dragons as their guardian!

(Source: Tapas)

items.title: The Perks of Being an S-Class Heroine
items.author: Grrr
items.description:
On the outside, Ailette Rodeline is an adorable child prodigy. Cooking, brewing tea, alchemy; you name it, she can do it. But this little girl has a big secret: Ailette is a transmigrator! After dying prematurely in her past life, she becomes a character whose world is destined for destruction. With all odds stacked against her, Ailette must figure out how to survive before her life is ripped from her again. Fortunately for her, she finds her salvation in… an insurance package?



(Source: Tapas)

items.title: The Constellations Are My Disciples
items.author: Cha Ji Woon, Indoor Kim, Studio Inus
items.description:
300 years ago, the invincible warrior Hyeon-Oh Kim brought down the Tower of the End, preventing the world’s demise. Though he should have died the moment the Tower of the End collapsed, Hyeon-Oh is reborn 300 years later in the body of a 17-year-old boy named Ju-Hyeok Kim. Meanwhile, he discovers the existence of the Constellations, who were once his disciples 300 years ago but were born during the time when he did not exist in this world. Will he be able to find them again and train them?



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

items.title: Martial Peak
items.author: Momo (II), Pikapi
items.description:
The peak of martial arts is solitary and lonely. It is an endless pursuit for unattainable heights as well. In order to surpass the limits of martial arts, growth and the will to survive in adverse situations is necessary.
One day, Yang Kai, a disciple-on-trial (and floor sweeper) of the Lingxiao Martial Arts Sect discovered a Wordless Black Book. That marked the turn in his luck and the beginning of his martial arts journey.



(Source: Webnovel)

items.title: I Want to End This Love Game
items.author: Doumoto Yuuki
items.description:
The first step to winning the Love Game is saying “I love you.” So how do you lose? By admitting you’re in love!



Let the games begin! Since childhood, Yukiya Asagi and Miku Sakura have played the Love Game, where they try to fluster each other with a simple “I love you.” But after falling in love for real and refusing to admit it, neither of them can afford to lose this battle!



After leaving behind his image as a quiet nerd, Yukiya’s ready to break hearts and take names with the ultimate high school glow-up. Well, he’s really just got one girl in his sights - his best friend, Miku! Using her favorite shojo manga as his weapon, he’s ready to pin her to the wall and gaze at her with a perfect smolder. Will his moves get her heart racing?



(Source: VIZ Media)

items.title: ReLIFE
items.author: Yayoi Sou
items.description:
When the responsibilities of being an adult and the ugly side of corporate bullying betrays one's childhood dreams, many would wish to return to their innocent childhood to relive their life and make the right decisions. Dumbfounded by the offer presented to him, 27-year-old Arata Kaizaki hopes to turn his life around through a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.



Returning home from his part-time job, Arata is persuaded by Ryou Yoake, an employee of ReLife Research Institute, into participating in an experiment which will help him overcome his difficulties and re-enter corporate life. As part of the ReLife experiment, Arata's physique is reverted to that of a 17-year-old, and all he must do is relive his high school life for one year. Waiting for him at the end of the experiment is a job offer that he has been struggling to get ever since he left his first company.



With few other options, he decides to go along with this plan. However, with adult-like tendencies and many years since his last formal education, Arata steps into an unexpectedly challenging territory—a normal day of high school.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)


Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

items.title: Neoman Boindan Mariya
items.author: Chae-Gun
items.description:
Following the advice of his imaginary friend Jason, who told him, "Treat all girls like stones," Park Jin-yong starts seeing every girl as a stone. But then Sunwoo, a female student who doesn’t look like a stone, appears before him, and for the first time in five years, the sight of a girl’s face sends Jinyong’s happy little circuits into overdrive...

(Source: Naver, translated)

items.title: Depressed Hero
items.author: Kod0me
items.description: A legendary hero burdened by the trauma and aftermath of endless battles struggles with his mental scars while continuing to protect a world that never truly understands his sacrifice.

items.title: Devil & Ice
items.author: Danut
items.description:
The reincarnation of the strongest beings from another world—an ordinary life is already out of the question.


The Heavenly Demon, on the verge of unifying the world. After a final battle with their sworn enemy, the Ice Witch, the two died together. They are reborn as ordinary twin siblings in the human world. But peace is fleeting. Now teenagers, reincarnated organizations are shaking the world. The world will never let the siblings live in peace while hiding their past powers. Former subordinates gather one by one. This time, the Ice Witch stands by their side not as an enemy, but as a partner.


Can the Heavenly Demon truly become the world's strongest once more?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

items.title: Jukji Mara Jwo!
items.author: 지와
items.description:
Yun Ha-Jin, living precariously between life and death. One ordinary(?) day, his life changes completely when he encounters a timid, mysterious girl protecting him and a grim reaper.

(Source: Naver, translated)

items.title: My Possession Became a Ghost Story
items.author: Sweet Hulu
items.description:
A monster lives in the Rohanson manor. It wears the skin of the dead Lady Evangeline. While she believes she is the heroine of a romance story, to everyone else, she is a haunted nightmare.

(Source: Manta)

items.title: Suyo Webtoon-ui Na Kang-Rim
items.author: Song Joon-Hyuk
items.description:
Na Kang-Rim is a high school student who generally likes webtoons. One day, he experiences something bizarre: the female main character from a webtoon he often reads appeared before him. 



The incidents that happened in the webtoon started happening in the real world too, but the problem is that there is no hero to save her this time! So Kang-Rim decides to become the hero and save her. 



(Source: Naver, translated)

items.title: Uli an Sagwieo!!
items.author: Song Joon-Hyuk
items.description: “Why do you keep asking if we’re dating? We’re just holding hands, we’re not dating!!” It’s a slice-of-life romantic comedy about couples who aren’t really couples!

items.title: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate
items.author: Akinoko
items.description:
Minato Seno’s high school life had just begun when his homeroom teacher requested his help with Nekozane, the cat-like chronic napper who sits next to him in class. Timid and socially anxious, Minato has never talked to her or even seen her face. But when he finally musters up the courage to wake Nekozane, she unexpectedly hugs him on the spot! Thus begins a sweet tale of two teens awkwardly stumbling into a new friendship, unaware that their feelings are slowly turning into something more!



(Source: Manga UP!)



Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, it was picked up for commercial publication with two volumes collecting the Twitter comics releasing on 2024-03-25 and 2024-04-25, with subsequent serialization in Big Gangan starting 2024-04-25.

items.title: The Tyrant Wants to Be Good
items.author: Ram Write
items.description:
Nothing was ever handed to Dorothea Millanaire. No attention, no love, no power. So she decided to take them for herself… with her sword! She accepts her fate when she is executed for being a bloodthirsty tyrant, only to wake up... as a child?! This is her second chance. She must not repeat history. She must be good.



(Source: WEBTOON)


Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

items.title: The Patron of Villains
items.author: LICO
items.description:
One day, I woke up as a noble inside the game I used to play. Unfortunately, the game ends in an apocalypse. With ten years left, I track down the future villains while they’re still kids and decide to raise them myself, hoping that a better childhood could stop them from destroying the world. Now, with criminals dropping like flies, the kingdom thinks I’m the terrifying mastermind pulling all the strings. What on earth is happening? I just wanted to enjoy the sweet noble life!

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Tears on a Withered Flower
items.author: Gae (개)
items.description:
Romance, flowers, and dates-- once upon a time, that was the perfect description of Hae-Su and Min-Cheol. Now, all Hae-Su has is the ashes of their marriage and a mountain of debt. But her world shatters completely when Min-Cheol cheats on her with a young coworker. Hurt and betrayed, Hae-Su finds herself drawn to Tae-Ha, a young man who seems desperate for her affection… and may be hiding more than he shows.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

items.title: Lucid Dream
items.author: Masatokki
items.description:
Ever had a dream so realistic you couldn't be sure what was real? Raeum has a special power - the power to control his dreams. His power will bring to life an eerie dreamscape that may reveal the key to unlocking the truth behind his past.



(Source: Lezhin US)

items.title: Kaji Daikou no Arbeit wo Hajimetara Gakuen Ichi no Bishoujo no Kazoku ni Kiinirare Chaimashita.
items.author: Shiohon
items.description:
Harusho Ootsuki lost his parents when he was young, and his grandmother took him in and taught him housework and cooking. Harusho uses his skills to start a part-time job as a housekeeper during the summer vacation of his second year in high school. The story begins when his first client turns out to be the home of the most beautiful girl in school.



(Source: Natalie, translated)

items.title: Fly Me to the Moon
items.author: HATA Kenjiro
items.description:
The prince isn't always charming.



Before Jeong-Yeon even has a moment to process the tragedies in her life, she's thrown into the world of the Clansmen, a group of terrifyingly inhuman beings. Without any hope or expectations, she takes her first step into this monstrous world. Will she be swept off her feet or just swept away?



(Source: Manta)

items.title: Falling for Her Secret Side
items.author: Ataru, Gozen no Ryokucha
items.description:
Unassuming bookworm Tanaka Minato never imagined he'd cross paths with the cold beauty of his high school, Saito Rena. But after a chance encounter reveals their shared love of books, they start meeting in secret, bonding over literary discussions. To fund his hobby, Minato works part-time in disguise to avoid breaking the school's no-job policy. At work, he often seeks advice from his co-worker, Hiiragi Rena, about his peculiar situation. Yet, something about Hiiragi feels strangely familiar...



(Source: Manga UP!)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

items.title: My Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected @ comic
items.author: Wataru Watari, Naomichi Io
items.description: Hachiman Hikigaya is an antisocial high school student with a distorted view on life and no friends or girlfriend. Forced into the Volunteer Service Club by his guidance counselor, he begins helping students with unusual dilemmas.

items.title: Haimiya Is Scary Cute
items.author: Kamiyama Sumu (神山すむ)
items.description:
At my high school, everyone fears Haimiya-senpai. With her sharp piercings, striking grey wolf-cut, and that brutally honest Kansai dialect, she has a reputation for being downright terrifying. Yet, for some mysterious reason...this intimidating upperclassman is kind and gentle only to me! The curtain rises upon this heart-fluttering romantic comedy about a terrifying-yet-sweet senpai!



(Source: Manga UP!)

items.title: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie
items.author: Maki Keigo
items.description:
Shikimori seems like the perfect girlfriend: cute, fun to be around, sweet when she wants to be… but she has a cool dark side that comes out under the right circumstances. And her boyfriend Izumi loves to be around when that happens!



(Source: Kodansha USA)



Notes: 

- Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed by Kodansha for serialization.

- Won 5th place in Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

- Includes 25 extra chapters.

items.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
items.author: Mikami Saka
items.description:
This story takes place in a particular town with two infamous schools in constant dispute: Chidori High, a boys' school predominantly attended by low-class students with damning grades, and its neighbor Kikyo Girls' High, with most of its female students coming from wealthy and prestigious families. One day, high school second-year Rintaro Tsumugi, a fierce-looking but gentle-minded student at Chidori, is helping at his family's patisserie when he encounters a female customer by the name of Kaoruko Waguri. Rintaro enjoys his time with Kaoruko, as she doesn't judge him for his appearance, but this blissful peace is quickly disturbed when Rintaro makes the discovery that Kaoruko is actually a student at Kikyo. This revelation marks the beginning of the two's strenuous tale, as they fight against the limitations placed upon them by their schools and surroundings in an attempt to find their own path!



(Source: K Manga)

items.title: Mission: Yozakura Family
items.author: Gondaira Hitsuji
items.description:
Taiyou Asano is a super shy high school student and the only person he can talk to is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura. It turns out that Mutsumi is the daughter of the ultimate spy family! Even worse, Mutsumi is being harassed by her overprotective, nightmare of a brother, Kyouichirou. What drastic steps will Taiyou have to take to save Mutsumi?! A spy family comedy - the mission begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)


Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

items.title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword
items.author: Fujino Omori, Toshi Aoi
items.description:
Will Serfort dreams of keeping his promise to a childhood friend by becoming a Magia Vander, one of the mighty magicians who sit atop the Wizard's Tower. However, he is unable to cast even the simplest of spells, leaving him to fight dungeon monsters to earn credits at Regarden Magical Academy. As if that weren't enough, he finds himself putting his sword skills to the test against a bullying professor!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

items.title: Shadow of the Supreme
items.author: Dubu (i), Min Yong Gi, Ubiram
items.description:
Yang-Cheon Ku, born to the virtuous House of Ku of Sanseo, the Little Star and next Head of House. Status: The world’s most hated demonic martial artist. Cause of death: Defeated during the Virtuous-Demonic War, tortured upon capture. Or so he thought. Moments after dying in the arms of his childhood friend, the Heavenly Sword herself, Seol-ah Wi, he finds himself back in the past. Already things have changed, but is it enough to ensure his second chance at life doesn’t end with the same regrets?



(Source: Tapas)

items.title: The Greatest Estate Developer
items.author: Hyeon-Min Lee
items.description:
When civil engineering student Su-Ho Kim falls asleep reading a fantasy novel, he wakes up as a character in the book! Su-Ho is now in the body of Lloyd Frontera, a lazy noble who loves to drink, and whose family is in a mountain of debt. Using his engineering knowledge, Su-Ho designs inventions to avert the terrible future that lies in wait for him. With the help of a giant hamster, a knight, and the world’s magic, can Su-Ho dig his new family out of debt and build a better future?


(Source: WEBTOON, edited)


Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

items.title: The Archmage’s Restaurant
items.author: Cha-ssi
items.description:
A young aspiring chef suddenly finds himself in a world of war, dragons, and magic. These two worlds couldn’t be further apart... or could they? Who says you can’t open a restaurant in a fantasy realm? I mean, what could possibly go wrong? A perfect series for fantasy, magic, and food lovers.

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Ichyeojin Deulpan
items.author: Spoon, Su-Ji Kim
items.description:
"I pray every day that this love dies, that I may love you only until today, and that tomorrow this love will be dead."


Thalia Roem Gürta, the ill-fated princess born of an affair. She grows up distorted amidst indifferent parents, hostile half-siblings, and servants who despise her. Thalia has protected herself by raising her thorns against everyone who approaches. Yet, even she becomes defenseless in the presence of one person. He is none other than the Prince of the East, Varkas Raedgo Sheerkan. Forced to be perfect as a retainer of the imperial court and the heir to the Grand Duke, he grew up with most of his emotions numb under discipline bordering on abuse. A man who exists solely for the honor and duty of his family. To keep a promise made to the late Empress, he enters into a marriage with Thalia's half-sister, Ayla, and Thalia, engulfed in despair, slowly falls apart. However, her love, destined for death, faces an unexpected turning point....

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

items.title: Inkya de Otaku de Binbou Dakedo Bijin Ojou-sama ni Osaretemasu
items.author: Minamoto Motomi
items.description:
Eiji is a high school student who lives with his unsuccessful novelist father. He's a shy, poor otaku, but he's a thoughtful boy who never forgets what his late mother taught him about the importance of compassion for others. What Eiji also admires is Aoi, the daughter of the president of a large company. However, Eiji couldn't even bear to look at her, given the huge disparity between them. One day, after school, Aoi greets Eiji when he returns home. Eiji is surprised when Aoi says something astonishing...



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

items.title: Uchi no Maid ga Class no Suki na Ko ni Niteiru
items.author: Kosho Satoi
items.description: Eiga, the next head of the prestigious Kujo family, is in a serious predicament. That is, love. He wants to approach Himeka, a girl in his class whom he secretly has feelings for, but because it is his first love, he can't think of a good way to do it... At that moment, he decides to ask for advice from Maria, a maid of the same age who serves the Kujo family...!?

items.title: Weak Hero
items.author: Seopass
items.description:
Once the bullies target you, it’s game over. The school is run by tyrants whose favorite hobby is tormenting the weakest kids in class. But then Gray arrived. This mysterious new student threatens to dismantle the established order. He may be small in stature, but his calculative and brutal fighting leaves unsuspecting opponents lying on the floor begging for mercy. Now the school's toughest bullies have to scramble to take down this new and unusual hero.


(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: The Dawn to Come
items.author: Gi Kang
items.description:
School is home to judgmental eyes and home a source of abuse. But that's ok because Junyeong Yun found an abandoned home where she could study to her heart's content. Unfortunately, soon after, Beomjin Kwon, the town's most notorious delinquent, has also begun using the home to catch up on sleep. As the two are forced to coexist, they come to learn about their reasons for avoiding others.



(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes two extra chapters.

items.title: Wolf Girl and Black Prince
items.author: Ayuko Hatta
items.description:
Fed up with her friends’ constant bragging about their boyfriends, high school student Erika Shinohara decides to make up one of her own. When her lie starts unraveling at the seams, her charming schoolmate Kyoya Sata agrees to be her pretend boyfriend, seemingly saving her reputation. She won’t get off that easy, however, as she soon discovers her white knight is actually a blackhearted prince! Now Erika must be at his beck and call or risk her lie being exposed. But is Kyoya really as blackhearted as he seems?



(Source: Shojo Beat)



Notes:

- Includes the one-shot "Junketsu Lullaby".

- Includes the one-shot "Pierrot ja Nee yo".

- Includes the one-shot "Kamatte-chan de Gomenasai!!"

- Includes the one-shot "Kimi wo Suki ni Natta Riyuu" (The Reason I Love You)

items.title: Hayate The Combat Butler
items.author: Hata Kenjiro
items.description:
Hardworking Hayate has a plan to pay back the yakuza—who are now the legal owners of his body parts: he’ll kidnap someone and ransom them for a mountain of money! But things get tricky when his would-be kidnappee—who as luck would have it is the daughter of a mind-bogglingly wealthy family—mistakes Hayate’s actions for a confession of love, and subsequently hires him to be her personal servant. At least his employment future is secure, or so he thinks…



(Source: VIZ Media)

items.title: Last Boss Shoujo Akari: Watashi yori Tsuyoi Yatsu no Ai ni Gendai ni Iku
items.author: KISHIMA Kiraku

items.title: Temppal
items.author: Team Argo
items.description:
As Shin Youngwoo has had an unfortunate life and is now stuck carrying bricks on construction sites. He even had to do labor in the VR game, Satisfy!



However, luck would soon enter his hopeless life. His character, ‘Grid’, would discover the Northern End Cave for a quest, and in that place, he would find ‘Pagma’s Rare Book’ and become a legendary class player…

items.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train
items.author: JIXKSEE
items.description:
Every night, Yeo-Un takes the last train home—same route, same time, same routine. But one thing keeps catching his eye: a girl with a guitar and a presence that lingers in his mind. When a shared love for the indie band Long Afternoon sparks a conversation, their late-night encounters begin to turn into something more. But Hae-In isn’t just another fan—she’s the voice behind the band, a secret she can’t afford to reveal. As music draws them closer, the truth may threaten to pull them apart. When the final note plays, will their story end in harmony… or heartbreak?

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Rich Girl Caretaker: I'm Secretly the Caregiver of the Most Popular Girl in This Rich Kid School
items.author: Mizushima Sorahiko
items.description:
A poor high school boy, Itsuki Tomonari, got caught up in a kidnapping attempt on Hinako Konohana, a young lady from one of Japan's largest conglomerates. On the surface, Hinako appears to be a brilliant and beautiful young woman, but in reality, she is a lazy girl with no life skills. However, due to family reasons, Hinako has to play the role of the "perfect young lady" at school. Wanting to protect her, Itsuki took on the job of caring for her. Eventually, Hinako began to spoil Itsuki with all her might -- "I don't want...... Itsuki to leave my side right now." This is a love story that begins beyond the master-servant relationship featuring a princess with a beautiful facade.



(Source: HJ Bunko, translated)

items.title: Becoming a Cheat-Level Skill Thief
items.author: Burgerman
items.description: After awakening an unorthodox ability in a fantasy world, our protagonist learns that copying and stealing higher-tier skills allows him to surmount any obstacle and climb to the pinnacle of power.

items.title: My Daughter Is The Final Boss
items.author: Geulsseunya, RK Studio
items.description:
Lee Seojun could only watch as his daughter, the witch Lee Seola, turned into the wicked final boss who destroyed the world and brought upon his death. Though never a good dad, as he loses consciousness, Seojun gets a new quest: “Change The Future.” Upon awakening, he sees a 5-year-old Seola standing before him. Now, Seojun must raise Seola to avoid the misfortunes that originally turned her wicked and become the caring father she never had. The price of failure? Only the end of the world.


(Source: Tapas)

items.title: Miss Hikaru’s Sparkling Proposal
items.author: Hideki
items.description:
One day, Yoshimi Numamoto is surprised by a girl he's never even seen before…proposing to him! Turns out, she's a sheltered, incredibly wealthy heiress! But while he's dumbfounded at why the highest of high class girls would go after a complete loser like him, she refuses to let up the pressure! Will his high school life ever be the same again?! You won't need an invitation to witness this romantic comedy! 



(Source: K Manga)



Note: Chapter count includes one volume bonus chapter.

items.title: Daytime in the Bunker
items.author: 2Myeon_z
items.description:
Seo-U always knew that running away from the son of a murderer would eventually haunt her, but she never expected to be locked underground with him. Years after she abandoned Won-Hyeok following a bloody secret on some stairs, a twist of fate traps them together in the suffocating darkness of an abandoned bunker. As the heavy door clicks shut, Seo-U must decide if the boy she betrayed is here to finally protect her, or if he’s been waiting all these years to exact his revenge.


(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: My Daughter Is a Dragon!
items.author: Yehaseong, Nn
items.description:
Graduate student Kim Jihoon's life is turned upside-down when the long-lost daughter he didn't know he had turns up on his doorstep. After he takes in his daughter Chaerin at her mother's request, Jihoon's life takes a surprising turn for the better. Things start going his way at school, and even his eyesight improves. Although parenting a precocious 7-year-old is a handful, Jihoon loves his little girl, and life is better than ever. It's almost as if there's some magical force at work...



(Source: Tapas)

items.title: Choeyakche Mawangui Seuseungi Doeeotda
items.author: Team the Sieg, Writing Eve
items.description:
A growth fantasy where the protagonist, possessed by a character-raising game,  turns the weakest Demon King into the strongest!



I had been raising a character in the character-raising simulation game "Evil Queen Maker" with the utmost care, only for the final villain to suddenly make her his bride.  When I sent a lengthy complaint about the ending… 



“Then go ahead and create a better ending yourself,” and I ended up possessed by the game’s “Evil Queen Maker”! To escape this game, I have to raise the Demon King and see the ending. But the Demon King I have to raise, Seere,” is only 7 years old. The weakest character in the entire world. Caught up in war and intrigue, as Seere grows older, he starts worrying only about how to gain the attention and affection of his teacher, Nahen.



“How do you even raise a kid?”


A parenting fantasy where the protagonist raises Seere to become the strongest Demon King.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

items.title: I’m the Max-Level Newbie
items.author: Maslow, Swing Bat
items.description:
Kang Jin-Hyeok, a gaming streamer, and content creator is the only person who has cleared the game, [Tower of Trials]. However, as the game’s popularity declines, it becomes increasingly difficult for him to continue making a living as a content creator. Jinhyeok prepares to end his 11-year-long relationship with the game and say goodbye to his humble group of subscribers. But on that very day, the Tower of Trials appears in reality with a message saying that humanity will perish unless all players clear each floor within 90 days. Jin-Hyeok, who knows the game better than anyone, decides to use his knowledge to his advantage and dominate the tower. It’s time to show everyone what a hardcore gamer can do!



(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

items.title: Reloaded into the Other World
items.author: wm (II), Yim Kyung Bae
items.description:
When Emperor Rustanard of the Rusclan Empire summons the Otherworldly Savior from another world to fulfill a prophecy, he doesn’t expect to find 16-year-old Sihan Seong. The emperor casts him out, only to have Sihan return with a party of six warriors to defeat the so-called “Mad Emperor” and set the Rusclan people free. Just when victory is within Sihan’s grasp, he is betrayed by his teammates and sent back to his own world. 10 years later, Sihan returns to the Terranor Continent and finds an unlikely ally in Alita, the daughter of Rustanard…



(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: My Fake Girlfriend's Defending Against Their Attack
items.author: 2396 Studio (二三玖陆工作室)
items.description:
One day, a girl suddenly confessed to me. In order to reject her, I had to find a fake girlfriend. I didn’t expect that my plan to avoid trouble… would lead to an even bigger mess? The Archery Club's tsundere "Mad Dog”, the flirtatious “White Fox”, the long-black-haired “Unattainable Flower”, and… my yandere bro-con sister! How did my youthful love story come to this?



(Source: Billibilli, translated)

items.title: Kuroi Heya to Shiroi Sora
items.author: LINDA
items.description:
1. Aru Kunoichi no Saigo

2. Shikan

3. Osananajimi

4-5. Kuroi Heya to Shiroi Sora

6. Hiraku no Toki

7. Shiawase no Nedan

8. Yasushi no Yasashisa

9. Discode-1

items.title: My Fave Persons Moved into Condominium Where I Live
items.author: Katakei, Touko Haruka
items.description: An everyday office worker discovers that her favorite idol and streamer has suddenly moved into the very same apartment building, leading to heart-fluttering encounters right next door.

items.title: After Ten Millennia in Hell
items.author: Nabi Gyegok, 4Player
items.description:
Oh Kangwoo the Demon King has had it with ruling over Hell and wants to return to Earth. But when he finally gets there, not only are his powers sealed, but the Earth he once knew has turned into an MMORPG free-for-all. Dimensional gates have appeared all over the world, and "players" enter them to make a living by hunting monsters. If Kangwoo wants to survive in this dangerous game, he's going to have to level up, and fast. But for this demon king, hell on earth might be worse than Hell itself! 

(Source: Tapas)

items.title: In the Sunshower
items.author: Si-Mok U
items.description:
Yun-Seul appeared in Sae-Byeok’s life for a brief moment, then disappeared like a fleeting sunshower. But mysterious circumstances have brought her back to the human world and into Sae-Byeok’s life once more. She needs to reclaim what was once hers. And in order to get it, Yun-Seul needs something from Sae-Byeok that’s more important now than ever: his love.



(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

items.title: The Extra’s Academy Survival Guide
items.author: Corita
items.description:
Ed Rothstaylor is a third-rate villain in a game, disowned by his family and kicked out of the dormitory for his misdeeds. One day, our main character wakes up as this very Ed, and realizes he must earn a scholarship so he can graduate and be set for life. Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game! Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: The Reborn Young Lord is an Assassin
items.author: Swing Bat, CoffeeLime
items.description:
Cyan Vert, illegitimate son of the Duke and the empire's greatest assassin, is betrayed by the righteous brother whose shadow he's always lived in. But just before the fatal blow strikes his throat, Cyan awakes to find he's just a boy again. The young lord has been reborn, and this time, he's not going to live in anyone's shadow!



(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Hakanai Kimi wa Moukou wo Hajimeru
items.author: KAZUTAKE Hazano
items.description: Kagari, an ephemeral beauty, reunites with her older childhood friend, Nana-kun, and begins her romantic assault on him.

items.title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy
items.author: Milhi Eun
items.description:
In the game Aether World, Baek Yuseol is considered the most useless character because he can't use magic like everyone else. His only skill, Blink, is a short-range teleportation ability most players consider worthless. But when he’s tasked with reaching the game's true ending, Baek Yuseol decides to use his unconventional skill to achieve this impossible goal. Can this so-called "trash" character outsmart his powerful peers, form unlikely alliances, and ultimately master the game?

(Source: Tapas)

items.title: Didn’t I Say to Make My Abilities Average in the Next Life?!
items.author: Nekomint, FUNA
items.description:
When she turns ten years old, Adele von Ascham is hit with a horrible headache–and memories of her previous life as an eighteen-year-old Japanese girl named Kurihara Misato. That life changed abruptly, however, when Misato died trying to aid a little girl and met god. During that meeting, she made an odd request and asked for average abilities in her next life. But few things–especially wishes–ever go quite as planned.



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

items.title: Demon X Angel Can't Get Along!
items.author: Filo Cat
items.description:
Demons and angels are natural enemies that have grown tired of fighting each other. In order to coexist peacefully, they decided to arrange a marriage between the two races! If the pair can't get along within the one-year trial period, the marriage will be dissolved. This is how Jiacheng (Demon) and Yu Shanshan (Angel) became the chosen "lucky" pair for the marriage. Sharing the goal of divorce, the two began their lives of "happy" cohabitation!



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

items.title: Ending Maker
items.author: 취룡, Chwiryong, DOES
items.description:
After "outboxer009" wakes up in the body of Jude Bayer from Legend of Heroes 2, he soon discovers that his rival "sandstorm" has also entered the game world as Cordelia Chace. These top-two-ranked old pros come to realize that navigating this game world is much harder than just pointing and clicking. With the apocalyptic conclusion of the game looming before them, they'll have to combine his quick wit, her foul mouth, and both their gamer mindsets to make a new, less cataclysmic ending. 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

items.title: unOrdinary
items.author: uru-chan
items.description: Nobody paid much attention to John—just a normal teenager at a high school, where the social elite happen to possess unthinkable powers and abilities. But John's got a secret past that threatens to bring down the school's whole social order—and much more.

items.title: Dreaming Freedom
items.author: 2L
items.description:
Jeong-Min is a loner in high school being bullied by the Queen Bee, Ju-Hyeon. The two were friends in elementary school before their friendship ended because of Ju-Hyeon’s demand that Jeong-Min should only be friends with her. Ju-Hyeon uses this “betrayal” to fuel the classmates' insults and isolate Jeong-Min in misery. Jeong-Min has only one way to escape, through lucid dreams. One day, a mysterious man enters her dreams and offers to help her get revenge on Ju-Hyeon…



(Source: WEBTOON, edited)



Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

items.title: My Sexy Snail Bride
items.author: Traditional Folklore / Modern Adaptation
items.description: Based on the classic Korean folklore of Ureonggaksi (the Snail Bride), a humble man brings home a mystical snail that transforms into a beautiful woman, turning his ordinary domestic life upside down.

items.title: All-Class Awakening: God Slayer
items.author: 绘世TONY
items.description:
Elias Bai, Captain of God's Legion, stood as the world's strongest Awakener until a brutal betrayal claimed his entire squad. Dying as a mere pawn of the ruling elite, he suddenly wakes up twenty years in the past—back in middle school, long before his awakening. With his loved ones still alive, Elias refuses to let history repeat itself. To save his team, exact vengeance on the traitor, and overthrow the corrupt system, he must walk a lonely road to unrivaled power.



(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Shokei Flag no Akuyaku Kizoku ni Tensei Shita ga, Shinitakunai node Yami Mahou wo Kiwamete Heroine-tachi wo Sukuimasu
items.author: AOZORA Akana
items.description:
After reincarnating into the world of a video game, our protagonist realizes he has become Diablo, the most universally despised noble in existence. His impending fate? A gruesome and brutal revenge enacted by the game's very own heroines. Determined to atone for the original Diablo's heinous misdeeds, he resolves to save the women he once wronged. By overcoming harrowing trials and pushing past his absolute limits, he will claim the ultimate power and rewrite his tragic destiny!


 
(Source: Gangan Online, translated)

items.title: Wo De Fangzhen Nüyou Hui Shuo Hua
items.author: Tan Xing
items.description: After losing his girlfriend to a tragic accident, a grieving young man struggles to find closure. Desperate to fill the void, he orders a highly advanced, lifelike AI android engineered to simulate his deceased partner's personality and appearance. While it initially provides comfort, the AI begins developing an autonomous, intensely sentient possessiveness. The comforting simulation quickly spirals into a psychological thriller as the boundary between artificial love and obsessive danger blurs.

items.title: The Mortifying Ordeal of Being Seen
items.author: mmk
items.description:
Being sexy can be mortifying, so who will be the first to tap out in this battle of flirtatious gazes between smitten seatmates Eguchi and Ikezawa?



(Source: VIZ Media)



Note: Originally self-published, the manga got licensed by Shogakukan and started being published on Sunday Webry since June 17th, 2024. The original first chapter was republished with some changes, the subsequent chapters are being published without changes.
